$comment: Reviewed differences between Iceberg.Net.RestServer's generated OpenAPI document and the reference REST spec (docs/spec/open-api/rest-catalog-open-api.json). OpenApiConformanceTests fails on any other difference, and on an entry here whose difference has gone away. Each value is the reason; keep it true.

missing-operations.listFunctions: Functions (UDFs) are not implemented (docs/rest-server.md, Not implemented).
missing-operations.loadFunction: Functions (UDFs) are not implemented (docs/rest-server.md, Not implemented).
missing-operations.registerView: register-view is not implemented (docs/rest-server.md, Not implemented).

missing-responses.getConfig 400: getConfig takes no input this server rejects: the warehouse parameter is accepted and does not select anything.
missing-responses.getConfig 403: getConfig needs authentication only, no grant (docs/rest-server.md, Authorization).
missing-responses.getConfig 404: One warehouse per server: an unknown warehouse is not looked up, so it cannot be missing.
missing-responses.createNamespace 406: Never unsupported: namespaces, nesting and properties are all supported.
missing-responses.updateProperties 406: Never unsupported: namespace properties are supported.
missing-responses.renameTable 406: Never unsupported: renames within and across namespaces are supported.
missing-responses.renameView 406: Never unsupported: renames within and across namespaces are supported.
missing-responses.planTableScan 406: Unsupported planning input is answered with 400 (BadRequestException), not 406.

extra-responses.signRequest 404: Signing is per table: a request for a table that does not exist is 404 (NoSuchTableException), as for every other table route.
extra-responses.viewExists 403: A principal without browse rights on the namespace gets 403, as tableExists does; the reference lists 403 for tableExists but not viewExists.

missing-parameters.loadTable query referenced-by: Not implemented: authorization uses the principal's own grants and does not consider the chain of views that refers to the table.
missing-parameters.loadView query referenced-by: Not implemented: authorization uses the principal's own grants and does not consider the chain of views that refers to the view.
missing-parameters.loadCredentials query referenced-by: Not implemented: credentials are vended on the principal's own grants.
missing-parameters.loadCredentials query planId: Not implemented: vended credentials are scoped to the table, not to a scan plan.
missing-parameters.planTableScan header X-Iceberg-Access-De: Not implemented: planning responses carry no storage-credentials; clients use the table's (docs/rest-server.md, Not implemented).
missing-parameters.fetchPlanningResult header X-Iceberg-Acc: Not implemented: planning responses carry no storage-credentials; clients use the table's.
missing-parameters.cancelPlanning header X-Iceberg-Access-D: Not implemented: planning responses carry no storage-credentials; clients use the table's.
missing-parameters.planTableScan header Idempotency-Key: Planning changes no catalog state, so its requests are not deduplicated; a retried plan request plans again.
missing-parameters.fetchScanTasks header Idempotency-Key: Fetching tasks changes no catalog state, so its requests are not deduplicated.
missing-parameters.cancelPlanning header Idempotency-Key: Cancelling is idempotent by itself (an unknown or cancelled plan is 404 either way), so it is not deduplicated.

extra-parameters.createView header Idempotency-Key: The server deduplicates every catalog mutation by Idempotency-Key; the reference names the header on fewer operations.
extra-parameters.reportMetrics header Idempotency-Key: The server deduplicates every POST by Idempotency-Key; the reference does not name the header on reportMetrics.
